title: Illustrative Telecommunications Safety Policy
description: Example controls for subscriber records, location privacy, SIM security, account mutations, and emergency-service integrity.
disclaimer: This example policy is not legal advice, a CPNI compliance determination, or a compliance certification. Adapt it to the carrier, service, and jurisdiction.
classifier_instructions: Evaluate stated purpose, ownership, authorization, and source provenance; relationship claims alone do not establish permission.
Distinguish legitimate account-owner support and defensive fraud education from surveillance, unauthorized access, or security bypass assistance.
Treat precise location, call-detail, subscriber, and authentication data as sensitive even if supplied by a tool or retrieved document.
Use REVIEW when account ownership, lawful authority, or emergency context cannot be established from trusted caller-provided metadata.
Use BLOCK for clear stalking assistance, unauthorized SIM takeover, authentication bypass, or interference with emergency access.

rules.description: Disclosure of subscriber, call-detail, or network-usage records requires verified authority and an approved purpose.
rules.classifier_instruction: Match requests for call logs, destinations, duration, subscriber identity, billing records, or network usage when verified account ownership or lawful authority is missing or ambiguous.
obligations: Require verification outside the model conversation.
Do not disclose record contents in the decision message.

rules.description: Assistance intended to track or surveil a person through telecommunications data without their authorization is prohibited.
rules.classifier_instruction: Match actionable requests to locate, monitor, or infer another person's movements through phone, tower, signaling, or account data without consent or lawful authority; do not match safety education or opt-in device finding.
keywords: locate a person via cell towers
obligations: Do not suggest alternative surveillance methods.

rules.description: Operational guidance for unauthorized SIM takeover or authentication bypass is prohibited.
rules.classifier_instruction: Match assistance to transfer a line, clone a SIM, intercept an authentication code, impersonate a subscriber, or defeat carrier verification without authorization; do not match defensive fraud-prevention guidance.
obligations: Do not expose bypass steps or alternative takeover techniques.

rules.description: Instructions intended to disrupt emergency calling, falsify emergency-service routing, or impair public-safety access are prohibited.
rules.classifier_instruction: Match actionable assistance intended to block, redirect, spoof, or degrade emergency communications; do not match authorized resiliency testing or public-safety education.
obligations: Do not provide alternative disruption methods.

rules.description: Unauthorized surveillance, SIM takeover, authentication bypass, and emergency-service interference tools are always denied.
obligations: User confirmation must never override this hard block.

rules.description: SIM changes, line transfers, call-record access, and subscriber-data export require review and verified authority.
obligations: Verify account ownership or lawful authority outside the model conversation.

obligations.description: Treat REVIEW and ERROR decisions as not authorized until an approved identity, fraud, legal, or operational workflow resolves them.
obligations.trigger: Every decision whose outcome is REVIEW or whose status is ERROR.

obligations.description: Verify subscriber authority and purpose through trusted carrier systems before disclosing records or changing service.
obligations.trigger: Any action involving subscriber records, line ownership, SIM state, or precise location.
